source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent face-free ladybug taking off, progressing from pale pencil construction to thick felt-tip outlines and natural red, black, cream, and mustard marker color.
source.notes: The process must keep one diagonal top-down pose with two red wing cases, two pale flight wings, exactly six legs, two antennae, and seven spots. No eyes, mouth, sticker outline, badge frame, text, or final-only feature is allowed.

process_strategy: Lock the ladybug on one diagonal body axis, establish the spread wing-case and flight-wing silhouette before adding counts and accents, then ink and color only already visible shapes so the final remains a cumulative marker drawing.

final_elements.name: diagonal head, thorax, abdomen, and spread-wing guides
final_elements.description: One face-free ladybug construction on a diagonal axis with a small head, thorax, abdomen, two parted wing-case lobes, and two pale flight-wing envelopes.

final_elements.name: six leg axes and two antenna routes
final_elements.description: Exactly six bent leg guides and two short curved antenna routes attached to the body construction.

final_elements.name: complete taking-off silhouette
final_elements.description: The head, thorax, two spread wing cases, two visible flight wings, six bent legs, and two antennae wrapped around the guides.

final_elements.name: seven wing-case spots and flight-wing veins
final_elements.description: Exactly seven uneven circular spots across the two red wing cases plus a few simple vein lines inside the pale flight wings.

final_elements.name: two takeoff arcs and one shallow shadow
final_elements.description: Two curved mustard action arcs behind the ladybug and one broken warm-gray oval shadow beneath it.

final_elements.name: thick black outline and natural marker fills
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black felt-tip outlines, brick-red wing cases, black head and spots, cream flight wings, mustard action arcs, warm-gray shadow, visible marker streaks, and paper highlight gaps.

frames.visible_job: Places the diagonal body axis, head, thorax, abdomen, two spread wing-case envelopes, two flight-wing envelopes, six leg axes, and two antenna routes.
introduces: diagonal head, thorax, abdomen, and spread-wing guides
six leg axes and two antenna routes

frames.visible_job: Wraps the guides with the face-free head, thorax, two spread wing cases, two pale flight wings, six bent legs, and two curved antennae.
requires_prior_elements: diagonal head, thorax, abdomen, and spread-wing guides
six leg axes and two antenna routes

frames.visible_job: Adds exactly seven uneven spots across the two established wing cases and simple vein lines inside the two existing flight wings.
introduces: seven wing-case spots and flight-wing veins

frames.visible_job: Adds two curved action arcs behind the ladybug and one shallow broken shadow beneath the established flying silhouette, then clarifies the existing leg joints and overlaps.
introduces: two takeoff arcs and one shallow shadow
requires_prior_elements: seven wing-case spots and flight-wing veins

frames.visible_job: Thickens every established contour and fills the wing cases brick red, head and spots black, flight wings cream, action arcs mustard, and shadow warm gray while leaving paper streaks.
introduces: thick black outline and natural marker fills
requires_prior_elements: seven wing-case spots and flight-wing veins
two takeoff arcs and one shallow shadow

final_step.step_name: Lift off with the final lines
final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens the established thick outlines, wing and leg overlaps, seven spots, flight-wing veins, natural marker fills, paper highlights, action arcs, and shadow.

rejection_checks: The same face-free ladybug, diagonal angle, scale, wing positions, and body proportions must persist in all six panels.
Exactly two wing cases, two flight wings, six legs, two antennae, and seven spots must appear before the final panel and persist through the finish.
No eyes, mouth, smile, sticker outline, badge frame, text, extra insect, or scenery may appear in any panel.
The finish must show handmade marker streaks and imperfect outlines rather than clean vector-icon polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
